Check and control: [ ] R — The core project can be explained without a script and its evidence can be retrieved.
Pass evidence and failure action: Explain problem, contribution, method, evidence and boundary, then locate the supporting table, figure, calculation, log, excerpt, test or primary source.

Check and control: [ ] R — Design choices and rejected alternatives can be defended.
Pass evidence and failure action: State the decision criterion, feasible alternatives, evidence available at the time, trade-off and residual risk. Do not claim that one implementation was the only possible design.

Check and control: [ ] R — Limitations, uncertainty, negative results and failure cases can be discussed without minimisation.
Pass evidence and failure action: Name what remains unknown, how it affects the claim and what evidence would be required to extend the conclusion.

Check and control: [ ] M — Generative-AI use or non-use can be explained consistently with every record.
Pass evidence and failure action: Identify consequential uses, affected artefacts, verification, data boundary and retained human judgement. Oral account, TRACE, manuscript disclosure and official declaration must agree. Source E3.

Check and control: [ ] R — Requested values, counts and citations are verified before assertion.
Pass evidence and failure action: Retrieve the controlled value or state that verification is needed. Do not manufacture precision or a source to maintain conversational flow.

Check and control: [ ] R — The strongest conclusion not permitted by the design can be rejected.
Pass evidence and failure action: Answer “What can you not conclude?” with the unsupported extension, responsible limitation and evidence needed to test it.

Check and control: [ ] R — Unknowns and genuine errors can be handled honestly.
Pass evidence and failure action: State what is known, identify missing evidence and resolution method. For an error, correct it, bound its effect and identify the authorised repair path rather than defending the unsupported sentence.

Check and control: [ ] M — Hidden real-time generative answer support is absent.
Pass evidence and failure action: Do not use generative answer support unless explicitly authorised by the current rules. Technical availability, private access or prior disclosure does not create examination permission. Source E3.

Check and control: [ ] R — An authorised second person has run an unseen hostile mock defence.
Pass evidence and failure action: Cover the problem, literature, design, execution, evidence, limitations, ethics, rights, AI use and route-specific conditions. Record failed answers, repairs and retest needs.
